caption.zh: 一次 Coding Agent 运行的工作区投影：允许的源码透传，敏感路径默认拒绝，被拒读取留下可审计的判定记录。
caption.en: The workspace projection of one Coding Agent run: allowed sources pass through, sensitive paths are denied by default, and every refused read leaves an auditable decision.

eyebrow.zh: 面向 Coding Agent 的最小权限工作区门面
eyebrow.en: The least-privilege workspace facade for Coding Agents

headline.zh:
把仓库交给 Agent 之前
先交给它一个默认拒绝的视图
headline.en:
Before you hand a repo to an agent,
hand it a default-deny view

sub.zh: 敏感文件一律不可读，越权读取需要即时授权，每次运行结束都留下一份可重放校验的暴露清单。
sub.en: Sensitive files stay unreadable, out-of-scope reads need just-in-time approval, and every run ends with a replay-verifiable exposure manifest.

title.zh: 默认拒绝，而不是默认全给

body.zh: 策略允许的源码路径正常读写；.env、*.pem、.ssh/ 等敏感路径在容器内的视图里直接 EACCES，被拒条目甚至不会出现在目录列表中。
body.en: Policy-allowed sources read and write normally; sensitive paths like .env, *.pem and .ssh/ get EACCES inside the container view - denied entries do not even appear in listings.

title.en: Out-of-scope reads, approved in the moment

body.zh: 被拒读取在终端内联弹出 y/N：批准后该路径本次运行只读放行，TTL 到期自动收回；拒绝就当场拒绝，没有后台等待。
body.en: A denied read pops an inline y/N in the terminal: approval opens the path read-only for this run with an automatic TTL expiry; refusal is immediate.

title.zh: 每次运行，一份暴露清单

body.zh: 运行结束自动落盘 exposure-manifest JSON：每个路径的读取判定、全部限时授权、注入的环境变量名字与策略摘要，且可由判定日志重放复核。
body.en: At run end an exposure-manifest JSON lands on disk: per-path read verdicts, all inline grants, injected env var names and the policy digest - replay-verifiable from the decision log.

note.zh: 真实录制：容器内挂载默认拒绝视图，内置 mock agent 尝试读 .env 被拒、申请授权、被拒 .ssh 后结束，暴露清单落盘。
note.en: Real recording: the default-deny view is mounted in a container, the built-in mock agent gets denied on .env, asks for the grant, gets refused on .ssh, and the manifest lands.

body.zh: 单二进制、零服务、零数据库。宿主机只需要 Docker。
body.en: One binary, zero services, zero databases. The host only needs Docker.

steps.code: curl -fsSL <release-url> | tar xz && sudo mv readscope /usr/local/bin/
cp policies/default.yaml readscope.yaml  # 按需调整 allowlist

title.en: Run the agent in a container

limitations.zh: v0.1 面向 Linux 容器（需要 /dev/fuse 与 fusermount）；macOS/Windows 用户通过 Docker 运行。
limitations.en: v0.1 targets Linux containers (/dev/fuse and fusermount); macOS and Windows users run it through Docker.

limitations.zh: 门面是工作区视图的执行层，不是沙箱边界：能直接触达原始路径的特权进程在门面之外，README 有完整边界声明。
limitations.en: The facade enforces the workspace view, it is not a sandbox boundary: a privileged process that reaches the backing path directly is outside its reach - see the README boundary notes.

limitations.zh: 清单记录环境变量的名字，不隐藏其值；值级隐藏与凭据代理在 v0.1 范围之外。
limitations.en: The manifest records env variable names, it does not hide values; value masking and credential proxying are out of scope for v0.1.

body.zh: 把整个仓库交给一次 agent 运行，意味着 .env、私钥和客户数据同时交了出去。网络出口管控不等于读取管控——ReadScope 在工作区这一层补上缺失的原语。
body.en: Handing a whole repository to an agent run hands over .env, private keys and customer data with it. Egress controls are not read controls - ReadScope adds the missing primitive at the workspace layer.

body.zh: 一份 YAML：默认拒绝，按 glob 放行读写。敏感路径被显式拦下，源码路径正常透传，规则即审计口径。
body.en: One YAML: default deny with glob allow rules. Sensitive paths are explicitly refused, sources pass through, and the rules are the audit basis.

alt.zh: 架构图：宿主机 readscope CLI 启动容器，容器内策略加载器、FUSE 门面、授权存储、运行器与清单写盘各司其职
alt.en: Architecture: the host readscope CLI starts a container; inside, the policy loader, FUSE facade, grant store, runner and manifest writer each play their part

body.zh: agent 撞上被拒路径时，终端内联询问 y/N；批准的授权只覆盖 read，带 TTL 自动收回，全程记录审批人。
body.en: When the agent hits a denied path, the terminal asks y/N inline; an approval covers read only, carries a TTL that expires by itself, and records the approver.

alt.zh: 流程图：加载策略、挂载视图、运行 agent、被拒读取走内联授权、结束落盘清单
alt.en: Process: load policy, mount the view, run the agent, route denied reads through inline approval, and write the manifest at the end

body.zh: 每次判定实时追加进 decisions.jsonl；运行结束由日志重放出清单——同一份日志永远重放出同一份清单，审计无需信任运行时记忆。
body.en: Every decision appends to decisions.jsonl in real time; the manifest is derived by replaying that log - the same log always replays into the same manifest.

alt.zh: 集成图：任意命令、Docker 容器、策略 YAML、exposure-manifest v0、goreleaser 多平台二进制围绕 ReadScope 核心
alt.en: Integration: arbitrary commands, Docker containers, policy YAML, exposure-manifest v0 and goreleaser binaries orbit the ReadScope core

title.zh: 为什么用 FUSE，而不是改造 agent

body.zh: 门面在文件系统层拦截，任何命令零配合生效：cat、grep、find、任意 agent——不需要 agent 集成任何 SDK。代价也如实声明：容器内 root 能绕过视图，门面抬高下限并留下证据，不是沙箱边界。
body.en: The facade intercepts at the filesystem layer, so any command complies with zero cooperation: cat, grep, find, any agent - no SDK integration. The cost is stated honestly: root inside the container can bypass the view; the facade raises the floor and leaves evidence, it is not a sandbox boundary.

body.zh: 判定实时追加，结束时由日志重放生成清单；readscope inspect 会当场复核一次。改过清单，重放立刻对不上。
body.en: Decisions append in real time and the manifest is derived by replay at the end; readscope inspect re-verifies on the spot. Edit the manifest and the replay stops matching.

tag.zh: ReadScope - 默认拒绝的工作区视图与可审计的暴露清单。
tag.en: ReadScope - default-deny workspace views with an auditable exposure manifest.
